description: Lists the data breaches HaveIBeenPwned has recorded for a domain (breach name, breach date, accounts affected, data types exposed, verified flag). It is the public breach catalogue, not a check of individual email addresses (that needs a paid key and is not offered here). Choose this tool for: Lists the data breaches HaveIBeenPwned has recorded. Close alternatives on this server: security_open_port_scanner (Lists the TCP ports Shodan has seen open on an IPv4); security_cookie_security (Lists the cookies a site sets on its public home page). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
